weak.desc: 同一個字反覆拼錯：choose 曾出現三種不同錯拼方式；跨篇重複出現的個人記憶點錯字：prasious(precious)、choise(choice)、achivement(achievement)、addvice/addvise
although...but 冗贅並用；In my concern/angle 代替 In my opinion
如 team have、website appears、every words surround 等
You/Your/If/It/When/Life/The 等字在句中被誤大寫，已確認為系統性錯誤，非單一字詞問題
敘事段落中過去式與現在式（含 will）混用
如 everyone effort to do something，已確認為穩定重複錯誤
efficient/effective、progress/process、contract/contrast、interesting/interest、exciting/stimulate 當名詞用
客觀描述段落誤植主觀意見
所有格 its 與縮寫 it's 混用
多個獨立子句以逗號直接連接，未使用句號或連接詞

weak.cat: worth to V 結構錯誤
weak.desc: 應為 worth + V-ing，如 worth to afford 應為 worth enduring
如 chat to（應為with）、interest to（應為in）、fit to（應為for）、impression to（應為on）
如 I still be present、it will hard to、is prepare 等
motivate/motive、considering/consideration、efficient/efficiency 等

weak.cat: 關係子句多餘主詞代名詞
weak.desc: 如 that it seem、that it use、which...it，跨三篇出現，2026/08 正式確認

如 to get and keeping、cutting and decide
As me recall 應為 As I；make my 應為 make me

weak.cat: 冠詞誤加（抽象/泛指名詞）
weak.desc: the friendship、the nature 等抽象或泛指名詞前誤加 the

portfolio.corrected:
After the Covid-19 trend, more and more food delivery service websites have appeared like grass. In this picture, these websites are using their own way to survive in the delivery war. For example, UBird's feature is that they have a wide range of goods and offer free delivery when you spend $100 — these two ways can attract students or other people who don't have much budget. The last one is Foodbear, which has the clearest intention of targeting high-spending customers. Foodbear collaborates with high-end restaurants, and its delivery fee is the most expensive among these three delivery websites.
For me, I won't use food delivery websites because I enjoy exploring the streets to find new restaurants. In this process, although I will be disappointed by some dishes that don't taste good, 〔語意待確認：I am still present when I find treasure restaurants〕. It is a sense of achievement, like a pirate finding treasure. However, if I want to be a couch potato, I will use food delivery services, and I will choose UBirds because I am not a rich man.
